entities.summary: Evander Frank Kane is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Vancouver Canucks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played for the Atlanta Thrashers, Winnipeg Jets, Buffalo Sabres, San Jose Sharks, and Edmonton Oilers. Kane was selected fourth overall by the Thrashers in the first round of the 2009 NHL entry draft.
